title: Show HN: Huzzah – a novel approach to coding with AI
summary: Huzzah is an experimental editor that introduces a novel interaction paradigm for coding with AI, allowing users to write pseudocode that is synchronized to real source code on save, with the pseudocode persisted as a record of intent. It aims to address the tedium of writing full sentences for coding agents and the complexity limits of AI-assisted coding, offering a middle ground between fully manual coding and agent-based workflows.
